notes.title: Update #041 - EA 0.07.010
notes.notes:
Hey survivors!

in today's update brings safe sectors.
As you probably all know the whole world is made up of smaller sectors that are gradually revealed on the map.
As of today, it is possible to secure certain sectors.

Security is done via "MCPO Point" claim sites and "Outposts".
Both of them require a daily supply of resources, if this is the case the surrounding sectors will be secured.
The MCPO Point secures its sector plus adjacent sectors to the north, south, east and west.
The Outpost secures only its sector.

A liberated and secured MCPO Point also activates the local militia.

But keep in mind that secured sectors are not 100% safe. 
Zombies and aggressive animals may still appear, but they are completely free of raiders (both on foot and in cars).

In secured sectors there are no attacks on your claimed and securedl ocations.

There are still a few locations in the world that are outside of the possible safe sectors at this time - these locations can be attacked.
As time goes on, more MCPO Points will be added to make everything secure.

There are two new "Transport Depot" locations in the world that will supply newly needed material.
Both are within safe range of the current MCPO Point locations. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828180/e2fce5cad269b4dcdc293905a6ec14b98c2790da.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828180/9268e0347d815a6ff18f6dd5c2aa0ae1febfcca7.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828180/3ef54163baaf55891580df465a0d2b59696d4886.jpg

Here is the full list of changes and new features: 

World Map now shows secure and non-secure sectors.
World Map unsecured sectors have a red tint.
A secured and functional Outposts now generates a secure sector.
A secured and functional MCPO Point now generates a secure sector for itself and surrounding sectors.
A secured and functional MCPO Point now activates the local militia.
MCPO Point now requires a daily supply of Outpost Resource: "material" to function fully.
Two new Claim Sites "Transport Depot", which add 2 materials per day.
The secure sector is now free of:
 - Raiders around roads.
 - Raiders in cars.
 - Zombie Bosses.
 - Attacks on locations.


I want to thank you for your support and patience - thank you very much!
Enjoy the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828180/586778385a4dc0ce3fac63921392cdb484a5211f.png

notes.title: Update #040 - EA 0.07.009
notes.notes:
Hey survivors!

After a long break, i have prepared a new minor update and improvements for you.
As most of you probably know, i was forced to take a little unplanned vacation and take a break from development.
The game itself hasn't been able (and still isn't able) to earn a full time development lately.

I was and still am forced to find other work and pursue development on this game when there is space and peace an development.
Which hasn't been very much lately.

Anyway, I did a little update, focusing on the little things that caught my eye right after this extended hiatus - when I played the game again and approached it differently than before.

Mostly that the game is too simple;)
And it loses the atmosphere I wanted it to have.

So here are the first small changes:

Options - sections have gotten a better and more understandable UI for switching sections
Fixed some visual bugs (on the go) - a lot of them are still in the game.
The traders around the roads (with weapons) now have very little chance of being encountered + there is also a chance that their caravan will be in flames and destroyed.
Claimed POI sites - Military Post - there are no more arms dealers.
After completing the tutorial, all cars in the game are very low on fuel.
Also, the content of the free petrol cans has been lowered - petrol is more valuable now.
The world map is no longer available in creative mode.
Some "Claimes POI sites" now have a better visible capturable point (the device where you submit the stripes).
The frequency of spawning some items has been reduced.
Improvements to prevent cars that aren't yours, but you were driving, from disappearing - But if you are too far away from them they will disappear (necessary for performance).
Improved overall interaction with objects, no longer so many issues during object targeting and interactions.


More to follow...

I want to thank you for your support and patience - thank you very much!
Enjoy the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828180/586778385a4dc0ce3fac63921392cdb484a5211f.png

notes.title: Update #039 - EA 0.07.008
notes.notes:
Hey survivor!

Today we bring you a new update that brings several major technical improvements.

First, the physics behaviour during car crashes into enemies has been adjusted. It was more complicated than we expected, but it worked out in the end. There's still room for improvement but the basic mechanics are, in our opinion, already much better than before.

Also, a tweak was made to the weather behaviour - it's globally colder at night. So nights are not entirely safe even in a forest location.
The frequency of spawn events on and around the road (enemy cars, npcs etc.) has been reduced - so the world is not too full of humanoid npcs - instead there are more animals and zombies (including big ones).

The character now makes disturbing noise - this is a working version , but...
If you're in a car that's started, you're attracting nearby zombies.
And anyway, if you shoot, you'll attract the attention of the surrounding zombies.

We want to thank you for your support and patience - thank you very much!
Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update #035 - EA 0.07.004
notes.notes:
Hey survivor!

we have another update here, which this time contains a few improvements.

From now on, it is finally possible to eat food directly from any storage (box, barrel, bank, mailbox, etc.) without having to move it to your inventory. This option is also applied to some drinks (such as energy drinks, etc.).

Buying ammo is now a little more comfortable. You no longer buy one bullet or a full-stack.
But instead of one bullet, you buy a straight smaller package - exactly:
Handgun Ammo - 15 pcs
Rifle Ammo - 10 pcs
Shotgun Shells - 10 pcs
Assault Rifle Ammo - 10 pcs
Arrows - 1 pc
The price of the package is according to the original price for the one bullet * number of pieces in the package.

Some uneven terrain and trees growing over the bridge have also been repaired (the whole world will be repaired in this way).

Outpost management has received a new information popup window, which is available on the map after mouse over on the top basic information. In this window, you will see where you draw raw materials from everywhere and where they are consumed.

Regarding Outpost management, you can find information from previous update notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1206670/view/3004448577822749639

It is now possible to lose the captured resource point as well. Once in a while, your occupied places are attacked by zombies. If this happens, it is necessary to go to the place and repel the attack. If you do not make it in time (within 10 minutes), you will lose the resort point and it will be necessary to capture it again.
This is a working version and we want in the future it is not too necessary to drive to each resource point under attack, but it was possible to avert the attack in another way or completely prevent attacks on some points.
We are working with the idea that every exempt outpost that has secured all raw materials would generate safe zones (without raiders) in a certain perimeter, and resource points would also be protected in this zone. 
But we also welcome any of your ideas and comments. Are the attacks not very common? As you would imagine their defense, etc. We will definitely find a common path and your ideas can make the game more fun.

Thanks so much for your support!

And don't forget any review of our game is very important and welcome - so don't hesitate and write it. This will help the overall game.

We want to thank you for your support and patience, you are amazing - thank you very much!
Enjoy the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828180/586778385a4dc0ce3fac63921392cdb484a5211f.png

notes.title: Update #032 - EA 0.07.001
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

today we bring you another bigger update. It took longer than we planned, but this is another shift in the whole game.

This update contains, among other things, two fundamental things, namely the new logic of firearms, including new weapons, and then the first steps towards outpost managements.

New firearms and their statistics.

Let's look at firearms first.
All firearms have newly their own statistics, which are visible in the inventory. This modified their firepower, accuracy, scattering of bullets, etc.
The original pistol was replaced by a new M1911. However, other pistols such as Luger - P08, Berreta M9, Desert Eagle D50, PB-6P9, Walther PPK, PPQ M2 and Glock Mk 28 are now available. Each pistol has slightly different properties and sometimes it is better to replace the greater firepower of the D50 with accuracy and better speed with PPK.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828180/23d49baeeff86b65f53c423b78e9106d262eb55d.jpg

Statistics for shotgun and rifle have also been adjusted.

Also, Assault rifles such as AK-47 and M16A4 are now available, which can be purchased from some retailers).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828180/e8c349045a299e48e4c6dc98e0b864aa00aa155a.jpg

Thanks to these new features of weapons, we are again one step closer to their future modification.

We must also not forget the possibility of re-repairing firearms - this is done directly in the inventory and to repair it is necessary to have new raw materials "Firearm parts", which can be obtained mainly by disassembling firearms.

Outposts Management

The next big step is outposts management. Our game is not a strategy, so it's not complicated, but it's still necessary (and will be in the future important) to plan what to do sooner and later.

All outposts now require special raw materials for their correct functionality. If they do not have a secured daily supply of raw materials, they do not offer, for example, mail, helipads, defensive NPCs, etc.
It is, therefore, necessary to ensure a daily supply of special raw materials such as Food, Water, Fuel, Energy, Medicines, Materials, Ammunition, etc.
These new raw materials are obtained by cleaning and occupying small specific locations such as a petrol station, a water windmill, a grocery store, etc.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828180/9f27d0f0633cceab6aece924e466197780bdf82e.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828180/2e2794b7b1fb01a4d017a6a2464e31ae63c7f124.jpg

These small locations only need to be occupied once, in the style of finding a given location, clearing from enemies, and paying a special starting fee (currency is "forest stripes" for killing enemies). Once you take up this space, the game automatically starts the process of delivering the daily resources to the outposts that require the resource.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828180/bb7b1c4ad88fcf723f10a4302e8536801e75faba.jpg

All information can be found on the game map (so far in the basic working form) and on a new board in each outpost.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828180/76ad8ea9b156e6d9c90690c53a9686d82efc12b9.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828180/68fc8a91a971a7472e3843e60576c37b630a368a.jpg

However, some of these small locations also require their own supply of raw materials, so for their operation, it is necessary to ensure their own supply.

But it's nothing complicated;)

Also if all outposts have a secured daily supply of raw materials, they will also reward you with daily rewards in the form of some raw materials such as (wood, duck tapes, etc.).

And we must not forget the new NPC - healer. This NPC will cure you for 1 cloth. NPC is available in outposts if the supply of raw materials (meds) is ensured.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828180/5bbfde545dd54fba93c686f5e7890d76207a6be0.jpg

Active Helipads

If the outpost has a helipad and has a fuel supply, it is now possible to travel quickly on the map using the helipad. Travel is only possible from and to the outpost with a secured helipad and fuel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828180/02b54d887b2a6643e655d36571312bd35cc522e3.jpg

Next:
There have also been several new changes in the world - mainly in locations around outposts, where there are new places with raw materials for capture.
And logically, a lot of repairs, debugging and other things were done in the background of the game.

We want to thank you for your support and patience, you are amazing - thank you very much!
Enjoy the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828180/586778385a4dc0ce3fac63921392cdb484a5211f.png

notes.title: Major Update #021 - EA 0.06.001
notes.notes:
Hey survivor!
After more than two months of intensive work, we can finally present you with a new update.

This is a really huge update that changes the whole world and brings new gaming experiences and activities.

Based on your knowledge of playing the game, our plan, and our overall vision of the game, the decision was made to suspend minor updates and take this crucial step.

This is to combine all small zones into one new big world, allowing you to drive your car wherever you want and improve the gaming experience as much as possible. And most importantly, preparing the ground for further updates and game content.

We hope you appreciate the new changes and also apologize for the current shortcomings.

Logically, it was completely impossible to fill the whole world with content. Therefore, excuse temporary placeholders (in the form of recurring buildings or events, etc.). All this will be further worked on;)
It was also necessary to temporarily ban the construction of a house outside the designated location.
In time, it will be possible to build anywhere, but at this time it would disrupt both our work and your satisfaction and joy of construction. There are really many places in the new world where each of you would like to build your own house. But these places are largely for future content (cities, villages, etc.)

The new world also brings an unpopular thing, namely the restart of your game progress.
So you will start with this update (from version 0.06.001) from the beginning.

But don't worry if you have an old (up to version 0.05.006)) game and you want to finish something there - it's possible!
The old "Legacy" version is now available in the Steam Beta branches of the game - as the "D4S Legacy version", you can play this version of the game for as long as you want (saved positions for this version are not deleted).

Writing the whole changelog is unrealistic, so below is not a list of changes - there is a lot :)

But here is a small gameplay of the first 35 minutes of the game:
[previewyoutube=a3zzk2lLt_k;full][/previewyoutube]

Or a small game sample from our last New World test (before the last adjustments):
[previewyoutube=js3iqXPr-Mk;full][/previewyoutube]

The game also newly requires more than 4GB of RAM - we tried to keep memory requirements as low as possible. But unfortunately, if we take into account the demands of the Win OS + Steam application itself, etc., it was not possible to keep the game below 4GB of RAM including OS, etc. Thanks for your understanding.


We want to thank you for your support, you are amazing - thank you very much!
Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update #015 - EA 0.05.001
notes.notes:
Hey survivor!

we bring you a new update. This update contains a lot of new elements that took time to implement, as well as a lot of things in the background of the game code (which are logically invisible, but you may feel them while playing;)).
The basic main element of the whole update is the focus on improving the Forest Zone. Where we trying to implement new game elements and mechanisms in a smaller space then we will be able to implement them into the main world.

A new reward system was implemented in the game (so far only in the forest zone).
Its logic is as follows:
You get special stripes for killing enemies (humanoid and zombies) and completing daily quests in the forest zone.
These stripes can be exchanged for empty boxes, which must then be delivered as filled (with things that can be made or found).
You will receive a certain number of points for each delivery. When you reach the required number of points, you advance by one level in this system and receive rewards.
Once you reach the maximum level, the system resets and you can repeat everything and get rewards again.

Another novelty is a special task for the zone (also currently only for the forest zone). It is a task to find a certain number of special suitcases that are hidden somewhere in the zone. These suitcases can then be sold and get a lot of credits. You will get the task only after completing the tutorials.

Special daily tasks are another thing we have been working on. It's not perfect yet, but we try to make the tasks a little fun and different.
You will have to help defend the attacked convoy, heal the wounded survivors, track down the bear, or save supplies from the crashed plane.
And tasks, when it is necessary to collect a certain number of raw materials, are enlivened by variability (they are not always the same).
Everything again only for the forest zone.

Another significant innovation is the underground location of the old mine, where there are enough zombies to get stripes.

A new weapon - a shotgun - will help you with all this, which is really powerful (but only for a short distance).

There is a lot and not everything can be written in the announcement.
The list below will tell you more.

We want to thank you for your support, you are amazing - thank you very much!
Enjoy the game!

If you have only played the tutorial - then it is strongly recommended to start a new game after this update (with regard to the change of ammunition for the rifle).

New content

 Forest Zone - New daily quests, which are not always the same (working version).
 Forest Zone - New delivery and exchange system, including rewards.
 Forest Zone - New location with mines.
 Forest Zone - New underground mini-dungeon.
 Forest Zone - Friendly armed NPCs who are defending their positions.
 Forest Zone - Traders for reputation.
 Forest Zone - Modified location around the helipad.
 New car "Forest PickUp (Offroad)", it is necessary to get car keys (as a final reward in delivery rewards).
 New melee weapon - Katana (So far the most powerful weapon at close range;)).
 New Ranged Weapon - Shotgun (Very powerful weapon, but accurate only at close range).
 The new enemy - the Zombie Boss - is heavier and more dangerous.
 11 new armor - a total of 15 armor is currently in play.
 New items:
 Ranged Weapon - Shotgun
 Ammo - Bullet .338 Win. Mag
 Ammo - Hull 12G
 Melle Weapon - Katana
 Forest reward system - Stripes "The Forest Zone"

notes.title: Update #010 - EA 0.04.001
notes.notes:
Hey survivor!

in today's update, we bring you new cars, creative mode, and other new things.

So let's take it gradually:

New cars
Enemies can now attack you and chase you both the classic version of HotRod and its Off-road version.
So you can confiscate both versions of the cars.

 Hot Rod - Classic
 Hot Rod - Off-road

There are also two new cars available to you:

 BB Buggy
 Farm Pickup

And a special:

 Snowmobile


BB Buggy and Farm Pickup must be constructed in your garage (on the lower floor).
A snowmobile can be found in the snow world around specific POI locations.

Junkyard
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828180/94d1b0d5055f6035c3d2f14dbdf99f97a3889870.jpg
A junkyard is now available in the home zone (near the petrol station) - this junkyard must be built (similar to your garage)!
The junkyard can also be found in the snowy world, both near the main helipad and in some POIs.
This building is mainly used for dismantling or selling your cars. It is necessary to drive to the appropriate junkyard gate.
Here you can sell/disassemble both the cars you have in the garage and cars you confiscate from enemies.
Your main starting car cannot be sold or dismantled!
You will get a few credits for the sale, but the main thing is disassembly, thanks to which you will get the necessary components for the construction of other cars.
You will also find a new parts dealer here.

Garage
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828180/caa2f419b1f44bf877f2b97d03b0b79fe9f132c2.jpg
Your garage now includes space on the lower floor for building new cars, as well as a new workbench for the production of car parts.
If you want to own any captured car (enemy or found) it is necessary to bring it to the garage door and store it in it.

New radio stations
we are glad to announce further cooperation with two new radio stations.
You will find the following new radio stations in the game:
GamerFM - gamer.fm
Reach Radio - reachradio.co.uk

Creative mode
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828180/529eac57db8daa11c648f65a05151534a8d07ed2.jpg
If you just want to build and not be bothered by survival mechanics, enemies, and the need to find raw materials, etc.
So this mode is exactly for you. Here you can build as you want and what you want.
There are currently two islands (forest mountain island and forest flat island).
There is also a garage and the necessary things (tools) and especially cars with which you can drive here.
We would like to connect this game mode to a steam workshop in the future and thus allow you to share your buildings among other players.

Scenario
There is now a "Scenario" section in the main menu, this game mode is not finished yet (but it will be soon).
Here, over time, you will find specific game scenarios separate from the main game. And you will be able to play new stories in different and specific conditions.

New content

 Junkyard
 Possibility to sell and disassemble the car
 New BB Buggy car
 New Farm Pickup car
 New Hot Rod Off-road car
 New Snowmobile vehicle
 New work table for car parts (inside the garage)
 New car parts dealer
 A new task for the construction of a junkyard
 A new merchant of goods for your house constructions (such as paint, OSB boards, etc.)

 Fixed UI behavior when storing a car in a garage.
 Fixed some issues in Merchant UI.

 It is now possible to bind Shift keys.
 New keyboard shortcut for hiding and displaying UI - F2.
 Bandits in "The Forest zone" are active only during the task tutorial (this is with regard to the daily tasks being prepared for this location).
 The sign in "The Forest zone" now also serves as an orientation map.

 Lots of fixes and debugging in the background of the game code.

 Enemy cars can no longer be obtained easily.
 It is no longer possible to get them just by clicking on them. It is now necessary to get in the car and take it to your garage (in front of the garage door).
 It is already possible to travel to a second helipad in the snow world (if it is built and repaired).

 It is not realistic, but it caused a lot of problems both for the players and on the background of the game.

notes.title: Hotfix #009 - EA 0.03.004
notes.notes:
Hey survivor!

this is really an unplanned hotfix / update.
But unfortunately there was a major technical bug in the game and some players have already reported it to us, so it's good to avoid further problems.
This is a problem with the possible loss of saved data for your built buildings in the "home zone".
It mainly affects players who have already started to build large buildings.
There was a technical issue at background that should be resolved by this hotfix.
Because steam Cloud does not allow you to restore previously saved data (it does not have an archiving system), we made our internal system for data backup (so far only for data of built buildings).

Hotfix

 Fixed data loss issue (hopefully).
 An internal background system that backs up your data for building elements.


Information:
If data is lost, please inform us and we will guide you how to restore previous data. So far, it has not been possible to do this somehow in the UI for easy recovery (given the need for rapid implementation).
We will keep improving it.
Warning: the backup is only held for a maximum of two days back (this really serves for situations where the player is playing and finds out after returning to the "home zone" that he has lost his built buildings.

From the upcoming Update 0.04.001

Since we have a unfinished content update 0.04.001 in progress, this hotfix also contains some things from this upcoming update (not everything could be turned off - it is possible that something will not work 100% correctly).
So only in points what is new (but will be 100% addressed for update 0.04.001):


 Enemy cars can no longer be obtained easily.

 It is already possible to travel to a second helipad in the snow world (if it is built and repaired).

 It is not realistic, but it caused a lot of problems both for the players and on the background of the game.

we bring you a new update.

Enjoy the game!

NEW CONTENT

 It is already possible to appropriate an enemy Hot Rod.

 Graphics Setting in Game Options now includes the option to set the fog density.


GARAGE

 The price for further improvements has increased.
 Improvements bring more items in the garage.
 The first improvement will bring you a new lower floor, where you will find an oven, additional storage space, and most importantly, a surprise in the form of a small (really small) demonstration of what we are planning.

 The lighthouse and watchtower in "The Old World" no longer contain a temporary compass (it is no longer needed - it was a temporary help for players who ended here when died).
 Emergency drop containers can now also contain duck tape and zip tiles.

 Modified logic and Body Warm reaction - new and better bonuses for staying in the car, etc.
 Reduced frequency of snowstorms.
 "The Old World" - Quests to find the base and watchtower have a new notification on the compass.
 Reduced global volume and range of helicopter sound.
 Duck Tape can now be purchased in the home zone when you have a friendly reputation.
 UI - Body warm status icon now has a "frozen" effect if your character starts to freeze.
 UI - Notifications (such as an increase in your backpack, etc.) now have a longer delay before disappearing.


FIXES

 UI - Fixed minor bugs in UI
 Daily quest - "Get Emergency Drop" can no longer be repeated several times a day.
 Cut scenes can no longer be skipped using RMB (which caused problems in the reactions in UI) - this is now possible using SHIFT + RMB.

notes.title: Hotfix #004 EA 0.01.005
notes.notes:
Hey survivor!

first of all, we want to thank you for your support, you are amazing - thank you very much!
We constantly monitor your gameplay, knowledge, ideas, and we write notes.

Logically, the game is not perfect and does not contain everything - it is just the first version of Early Access.
But one major problem here is - and that is balancing.
Predominantly in the snow zone is a big problem to survive. The game is really extremely hard there and it does not forgive.
The game employs you enough here by fighting, driving, etc. And it is difficult to pay attention to the extreme setting for survival (your states - fatigue, body warm, etc.).

That is why we have released this update (and previous hotfixes), which should make your stay in the snow zone more pleasant - but you still need to take care of your states ;)

Some things are only temporary but will allow you to enjoy the game more. And we will have more time to focus on it in more detail.

Hotfix #004 EA 0.01.005


 You will no longer lose the compass if you die.
 To be sure, a compass was added into the interior of the lighthouse and watchtower - for those who remained stuck on these places (zone - The Old World).
 Lighthouse - better-modified interior (some players overlook that there is an opportunity to sleep here, etc.)
 Watchtower - there is now also a helipad (it is necessary to repair it) to be able to return home (and you not have to drive around long through the map to the main helipad).
 Modified the logic of punishment for body temperature - it's no longer so drastic and you don't fall to the ground wearily (unless you're really bad at it;))
 The borders of the world no longer have such a drastic dark screen overlay.
 The armor is now only damaged if the outside temperature is lower.
 Removed merchants for higher reputation (currently it is unnecessary for there to be merchants for high reputation - because the rewards have yet to be adjusted and prepared) - In the Home zone.
 Added merchants for food and armor to the home zone.



Previous hotfixes

Fixing and balancing

Empty bottles no longer show the% condition, which in some situations caused problems with the subsequent handling of these items.
Tutorial task - to kill 3 enemies. No longer spawn an excessive number of enemies, when you perform this task at night.
Increased the frequency of dropped rewards (meat, etc.) from killed enemies.
